scope: Existing Wasm/statistics/AOT ELF bytes and read-only disassembly only; no build, engine execution or timing by this reviewer. This does not establish hardware causality.

wasm_facts.placement: Both growth sites are fixed-frame reservation prologues, outside the timed benchmark loops.

aot_facts.only_changed_instruction: Relative call to the same wasmtime_builtin_memory_fill stub at function offset0xea. The four-byte displacement begins at offset0xeb. The memory-fill stub itself is byte-identical.
aot_facts.hot_loop_instructions: Identical registers, instruction bytes, loads/stores, branch displacements, stack spills and bounds checks.

conclusions: The proposed lost-SSA/hoisting/bounds-effect hypothesis does not explain these artifacts: the hot run machine code is unchanged apart from call relocation.

A native code-placement effect is plausible: the main-body shrink moves run by32 bytes and the marking loop crosses a64-byte boundary in the candidate. This is a hypothesis requiring a controlled placement/policy comparison, not proof that a cache-line split accounts for the full measured slowdown.
Outlining only prologues or excluding source loops would retain both changed Sieve sites, so that proposed policy would not restore this case.

small_generic_trial.policy: Keep fixed-frame reservation growth inline; outline growth checks emitted inside function bodies.
small_generic_trial.implementation_point: Function::Finish already emits fixed-frame reservation separately; an explicit inline choice at that EnsureMemory call avoids a new analysis pass or byte rewrite.
small_generic_trial.profitability_reason: One prologue per activation has little repeated slow-code benefit. Body sites account for44 of51 growth checks in frozen Functions; Sieve has no body growth checks and its current two-site outline makes the module7 bytes larger.
small_generic_trial.expected_control: Sieve should regain baseline bytes if named-tail contraction does not apply; verify rather than assume.
small_generic_trial.alternative: Retain named-only and reject shared growth if a bounded placement policy fails controls.
small_generic_trial.excluded: No workload names, forced padding, benchmark-source changes or engine-specific magic alignment in the compiler.
